clauses.title: Scope – Requirements for
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements for J-type hook bolts and nuts, mushroom head seam bolts and nuts, and washers of aluminium for roofing sheets.

clauses.title: J-Type Hook Bolts
clauses.text: 3.1 J-Type Hook Bolts For  detailed information, refer to IS 6113 : 1970 Specification for aluminium fasteners for building purposes. SUMMARY OF IS 6113 : 1970 ALUMINIUM FASTENERS FOR BUILDING PURPOSES

clauses.title: Designation
clauses.text: 4. Designation — As an example, seam bolt size M8, length 20 mm and material HG 19  shall be designated as `Seam Bolts M8 x 20,  IS 6113— HG 19'.
